export function scheduledQuote(minutes: number): number {
  return reminders.reminderQuote(minutes, 0.1, "work").amount / reminders.reminderUnit;
}

evidence.reason: Return changed from {amount, value: amount} to {amount: amount+2, value: amount+2}; caller reads .amount, so the numeric contract shifts by +2.
Return multiplied by 2; tests only assert scheduledDelay(40) > 0, so positivity holds but magnitude changes.
Divides reminderQuote(...).amount by reminderUnit; the +2 offset is not unit-normalized and may distort downstream scheduling values.
Tests assert reminderQuote(30,0.1,'work').amount > 0 and scheduledDelay(40) > 0, which remain true after both edits, so no test directly catches the change.
